en.name: Star Wars Text Crawl
en.title: Star Wars Style Text Crawl: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A justified block of text recedes up a tilted plane over a starfield, in the style of the 1977 opening crawl. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
howto: Put the text block on a plane tilted with rotateX(45deg) about its bottom edge, inside a container with perspective: 405px and the origin at the frame centre (960px, 540px). The plane is 1700px wide with its pivot line at y=1040px, so the vanishing point lands near y≈135px. Set the text in Inter 700 at 67px on an 84px line, justified, with a 54px kicker and a 92px title above three paragraphs, and fade the top of the layer out with a mask that is transparent above 14% of the frame height and fully visible from 40%.

Move the block up the plane at a constant 210px per second with ease none, starting at 2.7s with the block top 30px past the pivot line, so about 16 lines show at once. Fade a short intro line in at 0.05s and out at 2.7s over 0.3s, and bring the 640-star canvas up from 0.16 to full opacity over 2.2–3.4s. At 9.0s the stars rise by 420px scaled by depth over 3.0s while the crawl fades 9.3–10.2s, then the mark appears at 9.4s, the wordmark at 9.5s and the tagline at 9.7s.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the starfield, the crawl and the lockup. Replace the kicker, the title and the three paragraphs with your own release notes and swap the cool blue #86b8ff for your accent. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.
faq: How does a perspective text crawl work?

The text sits on a plane tilted back with CSS rotateX, inside a container with a perspective value. The plane narrows toward a vanishing point, so every line is smaller than the one below it. Moving the text up the plane at a constant speed with ease none makes the crawl steady, and a mask at the top hides lines that have become too small to read.
Does this use the Star Wars logo or the film's text?

No. This recipe recreates the style of the 1977 opening crawl, a block of text receding up a tilted plane over stars, with its own text, its own font (Inter) and its own colours. It contains no logo, no marks and no text from the film, and it does not use the classic crawl yellow.

zh.name: 星战片头字幕滚动
zh.title: 星战风格字幕滚动：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 一块两端对齐的文字沿倾斜平面在星空上退向远处，复刻 1977 年开场字幕的样式。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个字幕滚动。
howto: 把文字块放在一个绕底边 rotateX(45deg) 倾斜的平面上，外层容器 perspective: 405px，透视原点在画面中心（960px、540px）。平面宽 1700px，枢轴线在 y=1040px，消失点落在 y≈135px。文字用 Inter 700，67px，行高 84px，两端对齐，上面是 54px 小标和 92px 标题，下面是三段正文；用蒙版把图层顶部淡掉，画面高度 14% 以上完全透明，40% 起全显。
文字块沿平面以 210px/s 匀速上移，ease none，2.7s 起步时块顶在枢轴线下方 30px，画面里同时约有 16 行。开场句 0.05s 淡入，2.7s 起用 0.3s 淡出，640 颗星的画布在 2.2–3.4s 从 0.16 升到全亮。9.0s 起星空用 3.0s 按深度上升 420px，字幕 9.3–10.2s 淡出，符号 9.4s 出现，字标 9.5s，标语 9.7s。
点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会做出星空、字幕和标识。把小标、标题和三段正文换成你自己的发布说明，把冷蓝 #86b8ff 换成你的强调色。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。
faq: 透视字幕滚动是怎么做的？
文字放在一个用 CSS rotateX 向后倾倒的平面上，外层容器设置 perspective。平面向消失点收窄，每一行都比下面一行小。让文字沿平面以固定速度（ease none）上移，滚动就是匀速的，顶部加一层蒙版，把小到读不了的行淡掉。
这个配方用了星战的标志或影片里的文字吗？
没有。这个配方只复刻 1977 年那种开场字幕的样式：一块文字沿倾斜平面在星空上退向远处。文字、字体（Inter）和颜色都是自己的，不含影片的标志、商标和影片里的任何文字，也没有使用经典字幕的黄色。
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
